sections.changelog: 2.37.25: the legal entity network, wave 5 (medical malpractice, the owner's top-priority vertical): 47 reference pages under the medical-malpractice-lawyer pillar covering the claim procedure from records to appeal, the heads of damage and the 2026 court-fee amounts, the health-ministry institutions (ombudsman, disciplinary tribunal, licensing registry, hotline), the eight core statutes section by section, and a doctrine glossary; related links also reach the site's existing malpractice articles. Plus the second-opinion audit of waves 1 to 4: 16 outbound links that were dead, soft-404 on gov.il, or redirecting are replaced with verified live official pages; the pillar hub now renders on the divorce, criminal and malpractice pillars whose theme template applies the_content outside the loop (it silently never appeared there before); the pillar is inserted into Yoast's BreadcrumbList schema for every entity page; hub existence checks collapse to one query per pillar; the seeder runs one wave per request under a lock, adopts drafts from an interrupted run instead of abandoning them, and a refresh pass re-renders untouched seeded pages when a wave's data file changes (pages the owner edited are left alone, detected by a render fingerprint). 2.37.24: the legal entity network, wave 4 (labor law): 47 reference pages with 2026 anchor numbers (minimum wage 6,443.85 monthly and 35.40 hourly from 1.4.2026, havraa 451.5 retroactive per the 18.8.2026 order, travel cap 22.60, unemployment daily max 550.76), the dismissal and resignation procedures with every statutory clock, the labor courts and enforcement institutions, the eight core statutes, and a glossary including the hitamrut case-law status. Every number sourced; three unverifiable items excluded. Same one-time wave seeding. 2.37.23: the entity wiring layer (owner order): every entity page now opens with a clean hierarchy line up to its money pillar, and every pillar page carries a practical-information hub listing its wave entities (fees, forms, institutions, statutes) in a two-column clickable grid. All links are plain parameter-free paths; only seeded pages render; nothing touches the simulation page or any bridge. 2.37.22: the legal entity network, wave 3 (real estate): 47 reference pages seeded as ordinary editable WP pages, covering the legal steps of buying and selling, the full official land-registry fee table effective 1.1.2026, the frozen purchase-tax brackets (through 15.1.2028), betterment levy, the registry and planning institutions, the eight core statutes including the 2017 fair-rental amendment, the official TAMA 38 status (in force until 18.5.2026 where extended), and a glossary. Every number sourced to the official fee notice, consolidated law texts, gov.il or kolzchut; the five unverifiable research items excluded. Same one-time wave seeding, never overwrites a living slug. 2.37.21: the legal entity network, wave 2 (criminal law): 47 reference pages seeded as ordinary editable WP pages, covering interrogation and detention rights with every statutory clock (24 hours, 15 days, 9 months), shimua and conditional-arrangement rules, public-defender eligibility at 2026 income thresholds, the criminal institutions from the prosecution districts to the probation service, the eight core statutes section by section, and a ten-term glossary. Every number carries its official source; four unverifiable items from the research run were excluded, not guessed. Same one-time wave seeding, never overwrites a living slug, status at /justice-ops/v1/entity-waves. 2.37.20: raises the Hadmaia professional-review bridge above the site fixed WhatsApp pill after live z-index measurement. 2.37.19: keeps the Hadmaia professional-review bridge above floating contact UI so the live action card remains readable. 2.37.18: protects the live Hadmaia professional-review bridge actions from sticky contact overlap while preserving the lead path and indexability. 2.37.17: polishes the live Hadmaia professional-review bridge with stronger visual hierarchy, clearer action chips and safer responsive spacing while preserving indexability and the existing lead path. 2.37.16: server-renders the Hadmaia professional-review bridge before the lawyers directory guidance while keeping the JS asset for form wiring, so the handoff is visible without depending on client-side insertion. 2.37.15: moves the Hadmaia professional-review renderer into a normal plugin asset and keeps only JSON config in the page, so the bridge can run reliably with optimization enabled. 2.37.14: hardens the Hadmaia professional-review bridge by printing the handoff script in the page footer so optimization does not prevent the live bridge from rendering. 2.37.13: bridges Hadmaia simulation product intent into the Justice professional-review lead path without passing case details, and renders a contextual lead bridge when theme Git pull is blocked. 2.37.12: the legal entity network, wave 1 (family law): 47 reference pages seeded as ordinary editable WP pages with clean English slugs, verified 2026 fee amounts and deadlines from official datasets, links to gov.il services and consolidated law texts, an internal mesh to the practice pillars and wave siblings, a plain link to the courtroom simulation, and the standing disclaimer. Seeding is one-time per wave, never overwrites a living slug, and reports at /justice-ops/v1/entity-waves. 2.37.11: removes the utility-page noindex list and the matching sitemap exclusions (owner order 2026-09-07: indexing is the owner's decision only; sitemaps are left untouched either way). The legal-tools archive index forcing stays. 2.37.10: 301 layer for the deleted 2025 winners (164 Hebrew legacy paths measured as pure 404s despite real summer-2025 clicks; each target verified live, off-topic pages honestly left 404; runs only on 404s after the theme layer) plus a one-time refocus of /posta/ away from another outlet's crime-news brand queries (title, description, and the outlet-profile section; via wp_update_post so a revision exists). 2.37.9: aligns main with the live-safe deployment. 2.37.8: makes the homepage AI simulation CTA a real raw HTML URL for crawlers, not only a client-side JavaScript repair. 2.37.7: cleans homepage public status language server-side so crawlers receive the corrected wording. 2.37.6: cleans public homepage status language and keeps the AI links wiring from 2.37.5. 2.37.5: adds safe homepage AI link wiring so visible buttons have real destinations before interaction. 2.37.4: adds a conservative premium visual bridge through the plugin channel while the theme Git pull is repaired. It improves the visible layer and simulation framing without changing URLs, public content, indexability, menus, or database records. 2.37.3: restores the HADMAIA courtroom simulation shortcode on /legal-simulation/ and routes the embedded arena to Hebrew by default. 2.37.2: legacy redirects back on (evidence-driven, pending owner approval). WordPress old-slug 301s and the theme's 2026-05-17 Hebrew-to-English slug map are restored exactly as before 2.37.0 — Search Console showed Google crawling those ranking Hebrew URLs as redirects until 2026-09-02, and 2.37.0/2.37.1 turned them into 404s. Still off: 404 permalink guessing and any canonical redirect on a 404. Shortcode stubs and native auto-update unchanged. 2.37.1: zero-friction r1. The theme's own redirect engine (exact legacy-path map on init, old-slug map on template_redirect) is unhooked by the plugin; two orphaned shortcodes render empty; Justice Ops native auto-update enabled once (owner order: no more manual update clicks). 2.37.0: zero-friction (owner order 2026-09-03). All content redirects off: WordPress old-slug redirects, 404 permalink guessing, and the legacy 301 map are disabled; unknown URLs answer 404 (canonical host/https redirects stay). Plugin now loads only public protection, update control, registration, lead routing, scheduler, sponsored cards, title/claims guards, practice rendering, internal links, calculators, document/rent/divorce generators, malpractice checker, and simulation embed modules. AI/content generators remain unloaded. Status routes: /justice-ops/v1/redirects-off, /justice-ops/v1/cleanup-2026-09. 2.36.0 = cleanup-v1; 2.35.19 = phase-1 recovery release.
